name: Maximum Largest Order Shattered Set
definition: For a linear order $\prec$ on $X$, call $S\subseteq X$ **$\prec$-order-shattered** when the down-shifted class $D_{\prec}(\mathcal H)$ realizes every trace on $S$, i.e. $D_{\prec}(\mathcal H)|_S=2^S$. The **Maximum Largest Order Shattered Set** is $\max_{\prec}\max\{|S|:S\text{ is }\prec\text{-order-shattered}\}$; it equals $\operatorname{VC}(\mathcal H)$.
graph_summary: Largest order-shattered-set size over domain orders; equal to VC dimension.
origin_references: The order-shattering sandwich framework is due to \cite{bollobas1995defect}.

monotonic.proof: Maximum largest order-shattered-set size equals VC dimension. Every set shattered by a subfamily is also shattered by its containing class.

p_monotonic.proof: Maximum largest order-shattered-set size equals VC dimension. Every set shattered by a projection is shattered by the original class on the same coordinates.

doubly_monotonic.proof: By definition, being monotonic under both subfamilies and projections is doubly monotonic.

c_monotonic.proof: A conditioning is restriction to a subfamily followed by a projection; hence doubly monotonicity implies c-monotonicity.

strictly_monotonic.proof: Maximum largest order-shattered-set size equals VC dimension. For $\mathcal H=\{000,001,011,100\}$, conditioning the third coordinate gives two fibres of value 1, while the full class also has value 1.
